references.text: Isaiah also warns about the consequences of not bearing good fruit, which is similar to the image John the Baptist uses.
The book of Psalms speaks of righteous people who bear fruit, in contrast to the wicked who are cut down.
Ezekiel uses similar language about trees that do not bear fruit and their fate.
Luke gives a parable of Jesus speaking about a fruitless fig tree, which mirrors the warning in Matthew.
Paul speaks of the fruit of the Spirit, which is in contrast to not bearing good fruit.
